footer.privacy: This site sets no cookies, has no analytics or trackers and loads nothing from third parties except GitHub. When you open a release, the server keeps a one-way hash of your IP address so that release counts each visitor once; the address itself is never stored. To show the latest releases, patch notes, links and contributors, your browser asks api.github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com for them, and avatars.githubusercontent.com for the contributors' pictures; <github>GitHub's privacy statement</github> covers those requests. The launcher sends nothing unless you allow it: <telemetry>what it can send, and how to delete it</telemetry>.
